sections.name: Sunset migration band
sections.description: Acquisition or product-sunset notice that converts anxiety into accountability: a letter-style note from a named leader with an accent-ruled pull quote, a three-step migration timeline whose deadline is stated as a date, and a single CTA to the canonical announcement post. The band layout compresses the same fact into a slim above-the-nav strip; keep it non-dismissible while a deadline stands.

usedBy.note: Panel below the hero: 'Peak is now part of UiPath', a continuity sentence, a CEO quote, and a Learn more link to the blog
Slim band above the nav announcing the ThoughtSpot acquisition, with a Learn More link to the press release

sections.name: Insight data cards
sections.description: Product-proof cards whose headline IS the metric: a big answer figure with a valence delta chip, an optional bundle LineChart or Sparkline preview, a how-I-computed-it trust line, and a drill-in affordance that implies depth beyond the headline. Data is plausible but obviously fictional (Meridian), so screenshots read as demos, never as customer claims.

usedBy.note: Q&A message card with the metric as the answer and the calculation source as supporting detail
Fictional NexaCorp dashboard cards: metric headline, delta, and chart previews, with sci-fi product names to signal fiction

props.type: Array<{kicker, value, delta?, tone?, trustLine, followUp?, chart?}>
props.doc: One card per metric. tone colours the delta chip (good | bad | neutral); chart is {type: 'line' | 'spark', points, labels?, ariaLabel} rendered with the bundle LineChart / Sparkline

props.name: footnote

sections.name: Curated collections
sections.description: Gallery-style curated rows under count-bearing view-all links: each row states its curation logic in the title and who picked it in the subtitle, with category chips above as a second navigation axis. Cards keep to thumbnail, title, one metadata line and one value line; rows scroll horizontally with a peeking card where four-up does not fit. For Alfred this is the playbook, integration, or report gallery.
